fact: The Ministry of Health's February 2025 Labor Management Procedures for the World Bank-financed Health Sector Transformation Project (P181385) state that subcomponent 2.4, Health Management Information System, under a component implemented by WHO, will finance ICT equipment at national level, training of staff and of health facility staff in data entry, interoperability between data systems, and HMIS standard operating procedures, with the project to support routine data collection through DHIS2.
title: Health Sector Transformation Project (HSTP) (P181385) Labor Management Procedures (LMP) (Final)
publisher: The Republic of South Sudan, Ministry of Health
